description: Details for one course id from list_courses (pricing rows, supplements, metadata).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for prices in this call. Usually EUR.

locale.description: Response language and site context. One of en, nl, da, sv.

school_id.description: Craft CMS school entry id from search_language_schools hits (field school_id). Not the CRM UUID.

startDate.description: Course start calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Typically a Monday from list_starting_dates.

name: get_course_details

course.description: Single course product with pricing rows and supplements for the requested start date.
